svg.title: Thesis submission: checks, review and defense
svg.desc: Connect file versions, formal checks, reviewer feedback and degree procedures. Solid arrows move downwards, gold diamonds are decisions, and dashed lines return after correction.Institutions differ in whether they require a pre-defense or non-academic-error checks, and in the order of these steps. Confirm the applicable policy and what each check covers. Thesis checks, review, defense and degree conferral are distinct states.

text.tspan: Thesis submission: checks, review and defense
Connect file versions, formal checks, reviewer feedback and degree procedures.
